notes.title: Gameplay Update
notes.content:
1. Stamina mechanism has been added to the game play to incentivize investigating and assassinating.

notes.title: Server Code Update Version 0.1
notes.content:
I proudly announce major improvements in Server-side code!

[h2]Some noticeable improvements:[/h2]

1. 2 major causes of disconnection have been resolved.

2. The lobby code stays consistent even after the game (duh).

3. Can play game after game without returning to lobby to ready up.

4. Lowered the chance of getting same maps repeatedly.

Although our team couldn't deliver new maps/modes as promised, they are also on the way!

notes.title: Developer Note - Upcoming Major Update 7/22
notes.content:
Hello.

It's been two weeks since the last news update.

Our team wanted to come back with the previously mentioned Server update and additional maps

But we decided to push the update to 7/22 Friday for a better quality

Below are the list of updates included in 7/22 Major Update

[h1]Main News[/h1]

1. [b]Removal of disconnection[/b] from games by upgrading the server code

2. [b]Improvement on game flow[/b] by allowing players to play a game right after another instead of heading back to lobby

3. 2 additional maps/modes


[h2]Side News[/h2]
These are things in plan for post-7/22 update. (Some may not be delivered)

1. Adding Stamina to running

2. Adding one time AI spawn ability to help camouflage

3. Balancing Grab the Chicken Mode

notes.title: Contents and Server Update Plan
notes.content:
It has been a week since the release of the early access. 

Despite the lack of contents, the game received more love and attention than it deserved.

There were numerous bug patches, hot fixes and localization in the past week.

And it has been a very busy week in all honesty.

To meet the undeserving attention and love, we are here to share our plans for the future updates.

We look forward to your continued feedback and attention.


[h1]Contents Update Plan[/h1]

We understand that having only 3 maps/modes make it hard to play repeatedly. 

Development Plan: Add double-digit number of [b]maps and modes[/b]. More details in the upcoming Development Update News.

[h1]Server Update Plan[/h1]
Despite having only 3 maps and modes, our server isn't too stable in handling the traffic.

Development Plan: Prior to adding numerous maps and modes, we plan to [b]reconstruct our servers[/b] for smoother experience.

We will do our best to keep you all up to date with the development news.

Thanks.
